data.name: CheckBoxExtraRangeForTempComp.ToolTip
data.value: If checked, the wavelength range will be slightly extended to guarantee that the temperature compensated wavelength shift does not fail to cover the specified start and end wavelengths. The wavelengths should cover the specified limits as long as the temperature remains within -10 and +20 of calibration temperature #1.

data.name: TextBoxNumCalPeaksOffset.ToolTip
data.value:
Wavelength difference between the spectrum obtained at the measurement fiber input and the Neon lamp fiber input. There can be a slight wavelength offset between these two spectra due to various factors such as tilt of the slit, lateral displacement of the center of the Neon fiber, etc.
A positive value in this box means that the emission peaks in the spectrum from the built-in Neon lamp are expected to appear at wavelengths greater than their actual wavelengths.
The value in this box has no effect unless AutoCal is turned on. Normally, you should not edit the value in this box. You should use the Shift Wavelengths button to simultaneously adjust the Wavelength Calibration Offset and the value in this box. The only time you should adjust the value in this box is if you are getting systematically different thickness measurements with AutoCal turned on compared to what you measure when it's turned off.
